purpose: Classify the relationship established by the cited evidence for each defined link; not an ordinal confidence scale, causal test, or company score.

labels.explicit_source_connection: The source expressly connects the named financial, project, stage, ownership or timing elements. The connection is limited to the relationship stated by the source.
labels.documented_sequence: Dated observations can be matched to the same instrument, named reporting unit or event across records; the temporal bridge is documented without a source claim that one event caused the other.
labels.contemporaneous: Financing and the specified portfolio/asset observation coexist in the reviewed period, but no specific documentary bridge links their changes.
labels.unresolved: The relevant relationship cannot be established for the defined unit or cutoff from retained evidence; missingness must not be recoded as absence or zero.

usage: Assign labels to individual dimensions. Source identifiers refer to source_inspection_scope.csv. Six requested dimensions are separated from the cross-domain linkage. No label is combined into a score. Recurrence in source-derived records is distinguished from fresh primary reinspection.
missing_data: Iberdrola monetary weights and Eletrobras project weights/stages remain unresolved. Constellation has one allocation snapshot and an unexplained residual. Dominion is not a principal-33 case.
